text: We train a neural network with gradient descent to classify sensor sequences and optimize model parameters using a validation set.
A Bayesian classifier estimates label probabilities from extracted features and compares predictive accuracy with a linear support vector machine.
This study evaluates deep learning models for time series forecasting using regularization and cross validation on a benchmark dataset.
We introduce a reinforcement learning agent that improves its policy from reward signals in a simulated control environment.
An ensemble of decision trees and gradient boosting predicts equipment failure from tabular observations and engineered features.
The proposed semi supervised learning method combines labeled examples with unlabeled data to improve classification performance.
We investigate transfer learning and fine tuning strategies for neural models trained on small domain specific datasets.
A probabilistic machine learning approach detects anomalies by estimating a latent representation of normal behavior.
This paper presents a language model adaptation technique that learns robust text representations from a large corpus.
We compare tokenization and subword encoding methods for machine translation between low resource languages.
The proposed named entity recognition system identifies people locations and organizations in multilingual news articles.
A retrieval augmented generation pipeline searches documents and produces grounded answers to natural language questions.
We study sentiment analysis for short social media messages using contextual embeddings and sequence labeling.
This work evaluates neural machine translation quality with bilingual corpora and automatic linguistic metrics.
A text summarization method selects salient sentences and preserves factual relations in long documents.
We analyze information retrieval ranking for questions expressed in regional language queries.
A vision transformer identifies objects in satellite images using patch embeddings and spatial attention.
We present an image segmentation network that outlines cell boundaries in microscopy photographs.
The method detects road signs in camera frames under changing illumination and motion blur.
We evaluate convolutional neural networks for medical image classification using chest radiographs.
A three dimensional point cloud pipeline reconstructs indoor scenes from depth camera observations.
This paper studies image super resolution with residual blocks and perceptual loss on low resolution photographs.
An object tracking system associates detections across video frames using appearance and motion cues.
We improve visual recognition by augmenting training images with geometric transforms and color perturbations.
A distributed consensus protocol coordinates replicated state across unreliable nodes in a wide area network.
We measure fault recovery and message latency in a containerized microservice cluster under node failures.
The storage engine partitions records across servers and uses replication to preserve availability during outages.
This study schedules computation across edge devices while reducing network traffic and response time.
A peer to peer overlay discovers service nodes and routes requests despite changing network membership.
We compare consistency guarantees for distributed databases accessed by concurrent clients.
The proposed orchestration method balances workloads between cloud servers and resource constrained gateways.
A fault tolerant messaging queue recovers unprocessed events after a broker restart.
We detect malicious network flows by analyzing packet metadata and temporal traffic patterns.
A secure authentication protocol protects account credentials using challenge response and cryptographic signatures.
This paper analyzes software vulnerabilities caused by unsafe input handling and evaluates automated static checks.
An intrusion detection model identifies suspicious access attempts from system logs and endpoint events.
We study privacy preserving computation that limits disclosure of personal data during statistical analysis.
A phishing detection system examines email headers links and message content to flag deceptive campaigns.
The proposed key management scheme rotates encryption keys and limits exposure after device compromise.
We evaluate ransomware resilience through isolated backups access control and incident response procedures.
